messages:
dave: Scheduling a config-only tweak for ap-south: lower ephemeral_queue_size  to 64 -> 48, reduce short-seq timeout 6s -> 4s, and slightly increase routing_weight for text-shaper-v1 from 0.07 -> 0.09. No model artifacts. Deploy-bot set for 2024-01-12T09:30:00Z. Canary plan: 2% -> 12% over 8m, then 30% after hold. Ask ops for a 15m watch.

lucy: Ack. Priya + I will monitor p50/p95, 5xx, and ephemeral_queue_drops. Added temporary alert on short_seq_timeouts.

priya: Heads-up: reducing short-seq timeout can surface client-side retries; watching client_retry_rate and soft-fail logs. Muting noisy low-rps tenants for the window.

dave: Canary config (for release notes):
```
route: text-shaper-ap-south
canary: {start_pct:2, target_pct:12, duration_min:8}
params: {ephemeral_queue_size:48, short_seq_timeout_ms:4000, routing_weight:0.09}
fallback: text-shaper-v0
rollback_thresholds: {p95_ms:1300, error_rate_pct:0.4, queue_drop_pct:0.2}
```

deploy-bot: Deploy started job=deploy-1700100200. Canary=2% for 8m. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/deploy/deploy-1700100200

ops-bot: Temporary alerts: noisy-low-rps muted for 45m; short_seq_timeout alert enabled.

lucy: Canary 5m in: p95=390ms, error_rate=0.02%, ephemeral_queue_drops=0.01%. Advancing to 6% per plan.

priya: Not seeing client_retry spikes except tenant-442 where retries up x3. Paging their owner to confirm expected backoff.

dave: Reminder: rollback automation will pin to text-shaper-v0 if p95 > 1300ms OR queue_drop_pct > 0.2% sustained for 2m. Runbook: /runbooks/config-rollbacks/text-shaper-queue-rollback.md

deploy-bot: Canary complete. Beginning staggered ramp to 30% over 12m. Applying config to shard sets incrementally.

lucy: After ramp check: p95=430ms, error_rate=0.03%, ephemeral_queue_drops=0.02%. No 5xx. Holding 15m for post-ramp observation.

priya: Will keep thread open for 30m post-hold. Release-note draft: "Config-only: tuned ephemeral queue and short-sequence timeout in ap-south for text-shaper-v1; slight routing weight increase; automated fallback to v0 on thresholds."

dave: Thanks all. Marking deploy job=deploy-1700100200 as successful after hold if no regressions. :white_check_mark:
